title: [LOGGED OUT] Phone menu items fit on one line each
reason: "About us", "Log in" and "Sign up" are each broken over two lines

steps.text: Open https://www.demoblaze.com/ with phone emulation (390x844) and wait until loaded.
Is each menu item ("About us", "Log in", "Sign up") shown on one line, not broken over two lines?
steps.saw: Shown as About / us, Log / in, Sign / up on two lines each (link height 64px vs 40px for one-line items Home, Contact, Cart)
